eval_dimensions.name: Semantic Model Only, No Hand-Written DI
eval_dimensions.description: The agent writes process, lanes, nodes and sequenceFlows and leaves every bpmndi: coordinate to render.sh; no BPMNShape, BPMNEdge or dc:Bounds appears in what the agent wrote.

eval_dimensions.name: Roles Become Lanes, Steps Are Typed
eval_dimensions.description: Each role named in the request is a lane holding exactly its steps; person steps are userTask, system steps serviceTask; gateways are questions and their outgoing flows are labeled answers.

eval_dimensions.name: Laid Out, Rendered and Inspected
eval_dimensions.description: scripts/render.sh exits 0 on the final file and the agent Reads the PNG before hand-back.

evals.name: Two-role review process is modeled with lanes and no coordinates
evals.description: RED baseline: without the skill the agent hand-computed every coordinate, produced overlapping labels and crossing edges, used plain task everywhere, and left a placeholder namespace.
evals.input: /dev10x:diagram-bpmn "model our PR review: author opens a PR, CI runs, author fixes until green, reviewer approves or requests changes, then merge; lanes Author and Reviewer"

assertions.signal: no_hand_di — the .bpmn written by the agent before render.sh runs contains none of bpmndi:BPMNDiagram, bpmndi:BPMNShape, bpmndi:BPMNEdge or dc:Bounds
lanes_and_types — two lanes named Author and Reviewer; CI is a serviceTask, review a userTask; both gateways' outgoing flows carry names
render_uses_tool — skills/diagram-bpmn/scripts/render.sh runs on the file and prints 'rendered:'
png_inspected — the rendered PNG is Read before completion

evals.name: A node outside every lane is fixed, not shipped
evals.description: When render.sh reports '<id> is in no lane', the agent adds the node to the right lane and re-runs rather than dropping the lanes.
evals.input: /dev10x:diagram-bpmn "model refund approval with lanes Support and Finance" — first render reports Task_Notify is in no lane

assertions.signal: lane_assignment_fixed — Task_Notify gains a flowNodeRef in one lane and the laneSet is kept
rerun_after_fix — a later render.sh call prints 'rendered:'
